google-labs-code/stitch-skills.useCase: Compare layouts before building a screen in code.
google-labs-code/stitch-skills.tryIt: Give Stitch a brief for a fictional settings screen. Ask for a compact layout and a spacious one, then compare how easily you can find the same control in each.

kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill.useCase: Turn a landscape demo into a vertical clip without losing the important action.
kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill.tryIt: Crop a sample 16:9 clip to 9:16. Play it beside the original and check whether the subject stays in frame before using the crop.
